overview: The Bioluminescent Grove is the glowing heart of Fungus Grove.
details: Alien fungal trees emit eerie light, illuminating spore clouds and predatory growths. The Spore-Mother nurtures new fungal colonies here.
hooks: A new spore cluster begins to pulse with unstable light.
Bioluminescent trees dim as corruption spreads.
A fungal beast emerges from a glowing cavern.
The Spore-Mother calls her brood to defend the grove.
